target_customer: Shopify brands selling subscriptions, from small merchants to larger brands migrating from ReCharge
problem: Shopify merchants needed subscription management that was easier and faster than the market leader, including Shop Pay one click subscriptions.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription management for Shopify merchants plus payments

founders.name: Kennan Frost
education: Dropped out of college at 19 (college not named)
founders.background_notes: TechCrunch in 2021 named him Kennan Davison and said he was an engineer at Hulu and a growth engineer at Pinterest; the YC page uses Frost. Skio pivoted from an earlier idea that went through YC. He stepped back from running the company about two years before the sale and kept a board role, per press.

competitors.name: ReCharge Payments
competitors.traction_then: described as the only serious competitor
competitors.funding_then: 227 million dollars raised in 2021 at a 2.1 billion dollar valuation

technical_complexity.rationale: Needed deep Shopify integration, billing, migrations from ReCharge and Shop Pay subscription support, which is solid engineering but doable for a small team.

defensibility.rationale: Subscriber data and migrations create some switching costs, but the category had several rivals and Skio won by speed and ease rather than structural advantage.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Shopify added native subscription features, and ReCharge, the leader, bought Skio in April 2026.

market_need_then: Shopify launched Shop Pay subscriptions in 2021 and the market leader had a large customer base, giving merchants a clear need for alternatives; Skio's seed article lists customers like Bev and MatchaBar.

branding.domain_note: Operates at skio.com, an exact match .com.

identity.voice_and_tone: Confident, direct and a little playful, for example the line that competitors invested in ads while Skio invested in people

branding.community_and_virality: Founder posts about the 105 million dollar exit drew wide press coverage in 2026.

brand_strength.rationale: Bold marketing voice and a short exact match .com; the brand mostly gained attention through the exit story, and the name origin and merch were not found.

pivots.from: Earlier idea that went through YC in 2020 (not named in the source)

outcome_analysis: Skio pivoted in 2021 to Shopify subscriptions, raised a 3.7 million dollar seed from Adjacent in December 2021, and grew mainly by migrating merchants off ReCharge. By the 2026 sale it reported about 32 million dollars of ARR and 4 billion dollars in payments processed on roughly 8 million dollars raised. Its largest competitor ReCharge acquired it for a reported 105 million dollars in cash, so the price comes from the founder's own posts, and the deal looks like market consolidation.
notes: Total raised of about 8 million dollars is the founder's figure; another aggregator says 8.3 million over two rounds, so a second round is likely but not documented. 105 million cash price is from the founder's posts, not an official disclosure. YC lists founded 2021 and batch Summer 2020 because of the earlier pivoted idea. Competition as_of is 2021-12 because Skio was founded in April 2021 after pivoting, and the only dated competitor source is its seed article; the merge warning about as_of is accepted for that reason. Founder surname differs between sources (Davison in 2021 TechCrunch, Frost on YC).
